Error: need to specify one or more cluster names *or* set `--all` flag
Usage:
  k3d kubeconfig get [CLUSTER [CLUSTER [...]] | --all] [flags]

Aliases:
CURRENT   NAME   CLUSTER   AUTHINFO   NAMESPACE

observation.command: k3d kubeconfig get 2>&1 | head -5; ls -la /root/.kube/ 2>/dev/null; kubectl config get-contexts 2>&1 | head
